topic: host-level configuration for running a bootc-UKI host with libvirt/QEMU GPU passthrough (VFIO, IOMMU groups, host kernel setup, and the host-side constraints)

subtopics.scope: bootc install layout on the passthrough host: systemd-boot, composefs backend, UKI signing, and why the bootc/UKI layer sits below the VFIO/IOMMU boundary; boot-time attestation as a GPU launch gate.
seed_queries: bootc install to-filesystem systemd-boot UKI unified kernel image
composefs UKI secure boot dm-verity boot chain attestation

subtopics.scope: host kernel IOMMU enablement: intel_iommu=on and amd_iommu=on kernel cmdline on x86_64, SMMU bring-up on ARM64, and verification that DMA is actually translated before passthrough.
seed_queries: enable intel_iommu=on amd_iommu=on kernel command line vfio passthrough
ARM64 SMMU IOMMU vfio passthrough enable kernel

subtopics.scope: IOMMU group topology: discovery via /sys/kernel/iommu_groups, group co-membership constraints, ACS, and what makes a GPU passthrough-safe.
seed_queries: linux iommu groups vfio pci passthrough isolated group
check iommu groups sysfs vfio script ACS

subtopics.scope: vfio-pci binding lifecycle on the host: managed=yes vs managed=no, sysfs bind/unbind, virsh nodedev-detach and nodedev-reattach, and device reclaim semantics.
seed_queries: libvirt hostdev managed vfio-pci bind unbind sysfs

subtopics.scope: libvirt domain XML for a passthrough host: hostdev subsystem=PCI shape, watchdog element with its four actions, and qemu:commandline overrides.
seed_queries: libvirt hostdev pci passthrough domain xml managed yes
libvirt watchdog i6300esb action poweroff reset domain xml

subtopics.scope: host-side misbehavior cutoff enforcement: libvirt qemu hooks (/etc/libvirt/hooks), hook phases, and the pause/poweroff/destroy/detach action ladder the host can execute.
seed_queries: libvirt qemu hooks /etc/libvirt/hooks qemu.d example script
libvirt hook pause destroy vm gpu telemetry cutoff

subtopics.scope: the kernel VFIO contract and its limits: binary device ownership, no percentage metering or VRAM quota, DMA unmetered without IOMMU, and the iommufd/cdev interface replacing legacy group fds.
seed_queries: linux kernel vfio documentation driver-api vfio device ownership
vfio iommufd cdev replaces vfio group interface

subtopics.scope: host-side policy and hardware constraints: virtio-gpu default, guest /dev/vfio suppression, IOMMU-gated passthrough access gate, SR-IOV and vGPU alternatives, and the required runner shape.
seed_queries: sr-iov gpu virtualization iommu acs requirements passthrough
nvidia vgpu mediated device mdev vs vfio-user qemu
